name: AI Agent Reliability Lab
description: Public research interfaces for inspecting observer effects, repeated AI failures, evidence-gated action and bounded failure memory.

routes.name: ReflexBench
routes.question: What changes after the model speaks?
routes.boundary: The browser check creates a user-selected orientation receipt. It does not score a model, certify safety or authorize deployment. The public repository does not include per-scenario raw responses and per-item scores for all nine reported models.

routes.name: WisdomBench
routes.question: Does the system repeat a known failure?

reported_exploratory_result.measure: Spearman correlation between initial score and Wisdom Quotient

routes.boundary: The public artifact supports recomputation under its included task, judge, model and scoring conditions. The exploratory correlation does not establish a population-level law, general wisdom, general safety or production readiness.

routes.name: Proof-Carrying Action
routes.question: Does this output have the right to act?
routes.released_invariant: A failed proof packet receives no action authority credit, including when repair work is proposed.
routes.boundary: The released implementation is a minimal reference protocol with synthetic proof packets. It is not a domain certification, production policy or guarantee of safe action.

routes.name: Cognitive Immunity
routes.question: How is a failure memory retained without spreading blindly?
routes.released_interface: A deterministic decay-and-reinforcement fixture for a scoped failure-memory rule.
routes.boundary: The released fixture checks the arithmetic of the public interface. It does not expose production extraction, routing, policy thresholds, private data or deployment automation and does not establish general safety.

shared_boundary: The public routes expose inspectable interfaces, fixed examples, validators, aggregate results and explicit claim limits. A passing public check is not a safety certification, deployment authorization or proof of general model reliability.
